findings.summary: `bindProgressionModals()` still calls `bindDayStructureForm()`, which accesses `dstr-reset-breaks` and `save-day-structure-btn` via `document.getElementById`. Both elements were removed from index.html when the progression view was replaced with a React mount point. `$()` returns null; calling `.addEventListener` on null throws `TypeError` on every page load via `initAdminModals()` in main.js, breaking the bootstrap sequence before login is functional.
findings.action: Make `bindDayStructureForm` a true no-op in `src/views/admin.js`, or remove the call from `bindProgressionModals` body.

findings.summary: `renderStudentQuizzes` in `student.js` uses chained dynamic `import()` to resolve `mount` and `QuizTaker`, while every other migrated render function uses static top-level imports. The mount point stays blank until both promises resolve (blank flash on navigation), and a silent failure leaves the view empty with no error.
findings.action: Add static `import { mount } from '../react/mount.js'` and `import QuizTaker from '../react/components/QuizTaker.jsx'` at the top of `student.js` and call `mount(...)` directly.

findings.summary: Multiple components use `style={{ ... }}` for layout values (`margin: 0`, `paddingLeft: 32`, `fontSize: 9`, `textAlign: 'center'`, `flex: 1`, `display: 'block'`) in violation of constraint 16 (all CSS from src/styles.css, no inline styles).
findings.action: Audit each inline style against src/styles.css and the original vanilla HTML; replace with existing utility classes where available.
